oracle_provenance: US statutory utility patent term, 35 U.S.C. 154(a)(2); independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded 20-year statutory baseline expiration date; not a Patent Term Adjustment/Extension calculation or legal opinion.

cases.question: Does a claimed expiration exactly 20 years after filing match the statutory baseline?
For a leap-day filing where the 19-year anniversary lands on a non-leap year, does the model correctly fall back to February 28?
Must a malformed filing date string be rejected rather than silently misparsed?
When a claimed expiration deviates substantially from the 20-year baseline, is that flagged for PTA/PTE reconciliation rather than silently accepted?
